page.overview:
Who is Early Creature?

This Early Creature is a creature that appeared in a flashback during Patience St. Pim's monologue in "Elemental". It represented the beginning of life on Earth.

The Early Creature appears to be a representation of a fish starting to walk on land. It resembles a green amphibian.
